justifications.reuse: No definition is added - scheduleRunSignature and scheduleFetchDue gain a parameter and a one-line inline predicate at docs/ui/state-loader.js:293 - so the added-definition cap does not apply; the capability 'select this project's runs' is already owned at docs/ui/crew.jsx:219 and docs/ui/crew.jsx:325 (crewRunsForVisibleProjects) but is component-scoped there, and the change extends scheduleRunSignature rather than adding a competing owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff c8b8fd834..19eea9741 touches exactly docs/evidence/fragments/the-page-paints-from-an-index/the-flow-refreshes-from-its-own-route.html, docs/ui/shell.jsx, docs/ui/state-loader.js and tests/test_page_paints_from_the_index.py, all inside the reviewed manifest's nine declared write paths, with no plan, index or sprint state in the diff.
